findings.title: Inventory and estimate evidence are caller claims
attack_path: A caller omits a security item or manipulates value, confidence, effort, or risk estimates.
The controller retains and ranks the structurally valid request.
An operator could make a poor work decision by treating the score as verified truth.
evidence: Completeness is labeled caller_asserted_complete or partial_inventory.
Reports expose all inputs and deny implementation authority.
findings.recommendation: Verify source inventory and estimates independently before acting.

findings.title: Ranked work cannot execute or escalate permissions
attack_path: A caller ranks crafted work references at the top.
The runtime stores data and returns an advisory report.
No project mutation, tool call, memory write, skill action, code change, or deployment occurs.
evidence: Reports set implementation_authority false and automatic_action_performed false.
Safe Mode blocks new ranking writes.
findings.recommendation: Keep execution behind separate authorization and quality gates.

findings.title: Closed parsing and parameterized storage bound untrusted input
findings.affected_component: Priority parser, CLI, and schema v73
attack_path: A caller submits malformed, oversized, duplicate, zero-denominator, or secret-like data.
Closed validation and secret scanning reject it before persistence.
Parameterized SQL and immutable triggers prevent SQL structure changes and later tampering.
evidence: Focused tests cover bounds, duplicates, zero effort or risk, secrets, CLI, and immutable rows.
The CLI reads one bounded JSON object and performs no shell or network operation.
findings.recommendation: Preserve closed schemas, positive denominators, and immutable rows.

findings.title: Source and evidence references are stored as non-executable data
attack_path: A caller supplies crafted titles or typed references.
The runtime validates and stores them without interpretation.
No filesystem traversal, network access, shell execution, memory promotion, or skill activation is available.
evidence: The prioritizer depends only on validation, hashing, integer scoring, SQLite, and Safe Mode.
No adapter dereferences source_refs or estimate_evidence.
findings.recommendation: Keep reference resolution outside the prioritizer.

limitations: Inventory completeness and estimates are not independently verified.
The formula is a transparent heuristic, not a validated optimal policy.
Security severity must be represented in expected value, separate from delivery risk.
No issue tracker import, dependency solver, source dereference, model call, network, shell, memory, skill, project mutation, or implementation authority is provided.
